Resolves train, validation, and held-out test partition policy.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Data Pipeline](../categories/data-pipeline.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `DataSplit` |
| Search words | split, train, validation, test, partition, stratified, dataset |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Training Dataset** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Required Dataset asset used as the Training source |
| **Validation Dataset** | Dataset | No | 1 | Optional externally supplied Validation/Dev source |
| **Test Dataset** | Dataset | No | 1 | Optional externally supplied held-out Test source |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Partitions** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Resolved Train/Validation/Test partition set plus manifest identity |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Split | train_ratio | `train_ratio` | Number | `0.8` | `0-1` | The run | Training fraction. |
| Split | val_ratio | `val_ratio` | Number | `0.1` | `0-1` | The run | Validation fraction. |
| Split | test_ratio | `test_ratio` | Number | `0.1` | `0-1` | The run | Held-out test fraction. |
| Split | stratified | `stratified` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Preserve class proportions when labels allow it. |
| Split | seed | `seed` | Integer | `42` | `0-2147483647` | The run | Deterministic split seed. |
| Split | label_column | `label_column` | Column of the incoming data | (empty) |   | The run | Label column of the data reaching the Training Dataset input; empty uses the Data Input's label. Set it when a step before the Split makes or renames the label. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a training control |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
New nodes expose Dataset role inputs and one partition output. Older saved graphs may still show Train/Val/Test tensor pins as legacy compatibility pins, not separate model-branch execution paths.
```

## Tips

- External Dev/Test sources are preserved by role resolution.
- Do not build separate Val/Test model branches from legacy pins.
